revised_tactical_hypotheses.tactical_thesis: Merge what EXP-001/003/005 paid for three times: one heavy auto-cycle unit on SC_01 [9,2] owns the pocket queue-clear (cell [8,5]), C07 (route-10 onward) and C04 tail-catch (cell [8,0]) as ONE deployment. A def>=322 dam at [8,5] (wscoot-class, cost 8) makes lane-01 pressure chip-only, deleting POCKET_MEDIC from the mandatory prefix. The [3,3] stub (cost 5, strong-class) solos route-2 and is retreated at ~frame 390, banking a refund that funds the anchor inside the EXP-006 survival window. Cost-6 duelist-class bodies (talr/nothin) solo routes 7 and 6 at one-third of OP-02's assumed price. Route-8 is the single planned conditional concession (unblockable, IR_04 empty) unless the verifier proves the roadblock-diverted path makes it cheaply killable. A flamtl-class battery on path-free [9,4] cycles +6 DP every ~18s from ~frame 1070 to fund the W05 [6,2] heavy and W06 flex.

revised_tactical_hypotheses.tactical_thesis: Change lane-01 topology instead of lane-01 economics: a cost-7 chip-immune block-1 dam at [3,5] (lmlee-class, IR_01's upstream legal tile) arrests route-1 alone indefinitely, while the wscoot-class dam at [8,5] owns route-3 onward. Splitting the queue means [8,5]'s block-2 never stacks route-1 with route-3, so pocket fire (dedicated [9,5], SC_04) need only guarantee route-3 dead by 941 - relaxing its establishment from ~frame 450 to ~600 - and route-1 has NO kill deadline at all (ground down later by a cheap [5,5] piece via SC_02). This buys the DP to hold route-7 with an early duelist, conceding only route-6 (conditional on refund arithmetic) and route-8. The lane-02 late rows are a true relay this time: nothin-class deploys for route-14, may retreat after route-23 to rotate the slot, with the returned stub as W06 flex - preserving OP-03's relay concept as slot rotation plus refunds rather than additive cost.
